item.title: Wildfires are more extreme in Europe and North America, but global burning is oddly decreasing
item.description: Experts say the world is experiencing two opposing fire trends because of human impact. Wildfires in Europe, Canada and the U.S. are high, and flirting with record levels in Europe.
